title: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships Mini-assessment
description: Check your understanding of 1.3.1 Info and Relationships.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: What might be missing when a heading is only a large bold div?
elements.feedback: A native heading exposes the role and level to software.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: How can related radio buttons expose their shared question?
elements.feedback: A fieldset and legend communicate the group and its question.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: How can a label be associated with an input?
choices: Match its for attribute to the input id
elements.correctAnswer: Match its for attribute to the input id
elements.feedback: A matching for and id creates a programmatic association.
